content:
Although there are reports suggesting Apple is still deliberating whether the cameras on its upcoming glasses product should be used for taking photos and videos, DuckDuckGo has gone a step further…

The privacy-first search engine company is selling a pair of sunglasses called DuckDuckGo Paso Robles, with the slogan being "Normal — sunglasses".

The company touts the glasses' selling points as including unlimited battery life, zero notifications guaranteed, and a "seamless offline mode".

Although the company is clearly using a tongue-in-cheek approach to deliver a privacy message, these glasses actually exist and are available for purchase. It's quite a clever PR move.
